notes.note: Richards had the second most in the game with 31 touches and 2 goals going at 87% efficiency. With no Bont he took control of the midfield and has been over 110 now for the last four in a row.
Richards was the only Dog over 100 this week. He did have the tag from O'Sullivan until the 3rd when it was released. A handy 28 disposals.
Richards has been one of the more consistent for the Dogs this year thanks to his great role. He had 26 touches and a game high 9 clearances to be one we can target if we need a midfielder.
Richards was the standout in this game with a couple of goals from his 32 disposals. He played the key role in the middle for the night.
16 touches and a goal for Richards as he had the equal team high clearances with 5. It was his first under 100 in the last three.
Richards was one of the best with his 28 disposals and goal as he got back to the great scoring we saw a few weeks ago.
29 touches for Richards but he did give away 4 free kicks and had a low efficiency. He was still the second best scorer for the Dogs.
This is back to back under 100 for the first time since rounds 1 and 2 for Richards. The key was his 60% efficiency which hurt his score.

Richards had dropped some low scores on us this season when the Dogs have struggled and this was no exception. Despite 9 tackles he also had 3 free kicks against and committed 10 clangers which dragged his score down.
Richards was the second top scorer for the Dogs and continues his good run with 28 disposals and an equal team high 7 clearances.

Richards was the top scorer in the game with his two goals and 24 disposals. This was his third time of having back to back 100+ scores and hopefully he can put three together for the first time this week.
Richards top scored in the game largely due to his 3 goals and his game high 10 clearances. A great bounce back after last week.
Richards did cop a bit of a knock early but was fine with his 19 disposals at just 57% due to the pressure of the Blues. His lowest score of the season.
Richards had 27 disposals with 6 clearances and 12 contested. This makes it 4 over 100 in the last 5 and he is certainly one to consider.
Richards was solid again as he has been bouncing around the 100 mark. A good return from last week.
Richards still doesn't look right but he still played 79% TOG but just the 18 disposals for his lowest score of the season so far.
After being in doubt again for this week Richards came out and top scored for the Dogs with his 13 tackles and 30 disposals. He didn't show any signs of discomfort.
Richards top scored and was the only Dog over 100 but he also suffered a knee issue that saw him helped from the ground. Watch the injury reports as he is a test.
Richards was a late out for the game with knee soreness but should be back for their Gather round clash.
Richards didn't back up that huge opening round game but still nothing to be concerned about. He simply allowed his captain to take the lion share this week.
Richards was the star for the Dogs and must be considered. He lifted his average by 12 last year and doesn't look like going backwards this season.
